--- NOTE: The Keeper's Watch.md ---
# The Keeper's Watch

1. [[The Watch Began at Dusk]]
    - Aside: [[The Log Was Read Only After a Wreck]]

--- NOTE: The Log Was Read Only After a Wreck.md ---
# The Log Was Read Only After a Wreck[^1]

The log was read by nobody until a ship was lost.
Then the inspectors read every page.

[^1]: [[@A History of Lighthouses - Rhea Vale]]

--- NOTE: The Watch Began at Dusk.md ---
# The Watch Began at Dusk[^1]

The watch began at dusk.
The keeper trimmed the wick every four hours.
The keeper logged the weather in a book.

[^1]: [[@A History of Lighthouses - Rhea Vale]]

=== END SEGMENT 1 STAGE 2 NOTES ===
